package game

// ticket:engine.switch-pt/v2 behavior tests: the switch_pt dispatch case and
// its narrow executor, driven through ExecuteAbilityEffect exactly as a
// resolving ability would. These prove the LAYER ordering the parent Layer 7e
// foundation guarantees (post-additive swap, not a Layer 7b snapshot): a
// printed 2/5 carrying a standing +1/+2 computes as 3/7, switches to 7/3, and
// returns to the normally computed 3/7 once the UntilEOT switch is cleaned up.
// New file per the frozen-registry/shape-test convention.

import "testing"

// oxWithBoost builds a 2/5 creature on the battlefield under player 0 with a
// standing (NOT until-end-of-turn) +1/+2 continuous effect, i.e. a creature
// whose normal computed P/T is 3/7.
func oxWithBoost(t *testing.T, gs *GameState, name string) *Card {
	t.Helper()
	c := NewCreature(name, ManaCost{}, 2, 5, 1)
	c.Owner, c.Controller = 0, 0
	gs.Battlefield.AddCard(c)
	gs.EffectManager.Register(&ContinuousEffect{
		Source:          c,
		AffectsSpecific: c.ID,
		PowerMod:        1,
		ToughnessMod:    2,
	})
	if p, tg := c.GetPowerWithEffects(), c.GetToughnessWithEffects(); p != 3 || tg != 7 {
		t.Fatalf("%s: pre-switch P/T = %d/%d, want 3/7", name, p, tg)
	}
	return c
}

// No targets: "Switch this creature's power and toughness until end of turn."
func TestSwitchPTExecutionSelf(t *testing.T) {
	gs := NewGame("P0", "P1", false)
	ox := oxWithBoost(t, gs, "Switch PT Ox")

	if err := gs.ExecuteAbilityEffect(0, ox, "switch_pt", map[string]interface{}{}, nil); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("ExecuteAbilityEffect(switch_pt): %v", err)
	}
	if p, tg := ox.GetPowerWithEffects(), ox.GetToughnessWithEffects(); p != 7 || tg != 3 {
		t.Fatalf("after switch: P/T = %d/%d, want 7/3 (post-additive Layer 7e swap)", p, tg)
	}

	gs.EffectManager.RemoveUntilEOT()
	if p, tg := ox.GetPowerWithEffects(), ox.GetToughnessWithEffects(); p != 3 || tg != 7 {
		t.Fatalf("after UntilEOT cleanup: P/T = %d/%d, want the normal computed 3/7", p, tg)
	}
}

// Target-creature scope, plus the ignore-noncreature/noncard contract: a
// noncard target entry and a noncreature permanent target must be skipped
// without disturbing any other permanent.
func TestSwitchPTExecutionTargetCreature(t *testing.T) {
	gs := NewGame("P0", "P1", false)
	ox := oxWithBoost(t, gs, "Switch PT Target Ox")
	bystander := oxWithBoost(t, gs, "Switch PT Bystander")

	targets := []Target{
		{IsCard: true, CardID: ox.ID},
		{IsCard: false},
	}
	if err := gs.ExecuteAbilityEffect(0, ox, "switch_pt", map[string]interface{}{}, targets); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("ExecuteAbilityEffect(switch_pt, target): %v", err)
	}
	if p, tg := ox.GetPowerWithEffects(), ox.GetToughnessWithEffects(); p != 7 || tg != 3 {
		t.Fatalf("targeted creature: P/T = %d/%d, want 7/3", p, tg)
	}
	if p, tg := bystander.GetPowerWithEffects(), bystander.GetToughnessWithEffects(); p != 3 || tg != 7 {
		t.Fatalf("untargeted creature changed: P/T = %d/%d, want 3/7", p, tg)
	}

	gs.EffectManager.RemoveUntilEOT()
	if p, tg := ox.GetPowerWithEffects(), ox.GetToughnessWithEffects(); p != 3 || tg != 7 {
		t.Fatalf("targeted creature after cleanup: P/T = %d/%d, want 3/7", p, tg)
	}
}

// Each-creature scope: "Switch the power and toughness of each creature you
// control until end of turn."
func TestSwitchPTExecutionEachCreature(t *testing.T) {
	gs := NewGame("P0", "P1", false)
	a := oxWithBoost(t, gs, "Switch PT Each A")
	b := oxWithBoost(t, gs, "Switch PT Each B")

	value := map[string]interface{}{"target": "each", "controller": "you"}
	if err := gs.ExecuteAbilityEffect(0, a, "switch_pt", value, nil); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("ExecuteAbilityEffect(switch_pt, each): %v", err)
	}
	for _, c := range []*Card{a, b} {
		if p, tg := c.GetPowerWithEffects(), c.GetToughnessWithEffects(); p != 7 || tg != 3 {
			t.Fatalf("%s: P/T = %d/%d, want 7/3", c.Name, p, tg)
		}
	}

	gs.EffectManager.RemoveUntilEOT()
	for _, c := range []*Card{a, b} {
		if p, tg := c.GetPowerWithEffects(), c.GetToughnessWithEffects(); p != 3 || tg != 7 {
			t.Fatalf("%s after cleanup: P/T = %d/%d, want 3/7", c.Name, p, tg)
		}
	}
}

// switchPTObject builds the resolving-ability StackObject that carries a

func switchPTObject(source *Card, value map[string]interface{}, targets []Target) *StackObject {
	return &StackObject{
		IsAbility:   true,
		Text:        "switch_pt",
		Controller:  0,
		Card:        source,
		EffectValue: value,
		Targets:     targets,
	}
